description: This Java class, PasswordPreferencesHelper, provides helper methods to interact with password preferences through REST API calls. It includes methods to update preferences, handle invalid IDs, retrieve preferences, and get active password preference ID, primarily used for integration testing purposes.

classes.name: PasswordPreferencesHelper
classes.description: A utility class designed for integration tests to manipulate and retrieve password preferences via REST API calls.

methods.name: updatePasswordPreferences
methods.description: Updates the password preferences with a given validation policy ID by making a PUT request to the API.

methods.name: updateWithInvalidValidationPolicyId
methods.description: Attempts to update password preferences using an invalid validation policy ID, to test error handling.

methods.name: updatePreferencesAsJson
methods.description: Converts a validation policy ID into JSON format for API requests.

methods.name: updatePreferencesWithInvalidId
methods.description: Generates JSON payload with an invalid validation policy ID.

methods.name: getActivePasswordPreference
methods.description: Retrieves the active password preference ID via GET request.

methods.name: getAllPreferences
methods.description: Fetches all password preferences template data.
